strings.en: 1. Destroy all enemies
1. All allies destroyed
PLS Black Point... I didn't want to make any detours, but...
Dr. Tarsan said that planet's energy was rising...
Yeah, I hope nothing's going on...
Well, it was right on our way. Let's check it out quick... Hey!
Huh? Something wrong?
Whoa!? Aren't the asteroids in different spots from last time!?
Hm? Now that you mention it... The asteroids are moving?
Moving where...? Predict their course!
Moving...? If it's no problem, I'd rather ignore it for now, but...
True... but it does bother me...
I've got a bad feeling about this...
I've got the asteroid's course! It's heading for Earth... Earth!
Earth!? Then if we leave this thing alone...
It'll crash into Earth?
What? Ridiculous. Are you saying the planet has a will of its own?
But if it's true... at this rate, this asteroid will hit Earth...?
...But it's moving pretty slowly.
I think it'll take quite a while to reach Earth.
Then... shouldn't we stay away from it?
Let sleeping dogs lie, right?
Yeah, yeah, let's just ignore it for now! We gotta stop the colony first...
I'd like to look into it more... but I guess it can't be helped for now...
Even if we stop the colony, it looks like we'll stay busy for a while...
This sucks. Lately nothing's ever clear-cut!
Don't get worked up, Fujiwara.
If it's no immediate problem, chasing the colony comes first.
Right, right. The only thing worth getting worked up over is love.
Ah!
Damn! Did we get too close!?
What...? This feels different from the enemies we've met so far...
Fujiwara! Isn't this 'cause you were making such a racket!?
What, you wanna go!? You've been picking fights with me lately!
Shut up! The enemy's out, quit squawking at each other!
Whoa, this is getting out of hand, Lenny!
Geez! What are you doing!
...I'm sorry.
Quit fooling around, Shinobu!
These guys are way too much alike...
...Has that planet's territory grown since last time?
Whatever the reason, they're out now, so what can you do?
Looks like we've gotta intercept 'em.
So it seems... The road after the colony won't be an easy one.
We can't be held up here... Let's go, Maria.
Okay, Brother!
All hands, intercept the enemy!
We still don't know exactly what these things are.
Everyone, be careful!
Understood. Joe, don't do anything reckless either!
Heh, once I blast 'em, who cares what they are!
Aww, man, Big Bro's always like this.
Well, isn't he the type that fits in with Londo Bell?
More like the Cyber Beast Force, don't you think?
No comment.
...Good grief.
Wh-What, what!? More of them swarming out!?
Same pattern as before. They sure don't get tired of it...
...It's different... Ryo.
Hm?
(Sa... ra... Sara...)
That robot... the blue one, right shoulder trembling... Look familiar!?
...What!? That's...!
What's up? You know that mech?
Someone you've fought before?
Shapiro... It's Shapiro!
Someone... you know?
Shapiro... You mean Shapiro Keats!?
Who? Someone famous?
Shapiro Keats...
I heard he defected to the Muge Zorbados Empire in the last war...
But his death was supposedly confirmed when the Muge Empire fell.
...Seems the brass still remember you well, Shapiro...!
That's right, I'm the one who finished him off. No... mistake.
Huh!? "Death confirmed" means he died, right?
Sara, he's dead!
Somebody just happened to pick up Shapiro's mech and is using it...
Whoever's piloting that mech doesn't matter!
Right now, getting out of here comes first!
...Yeah. Got it, Captain.
Lord Shapiro!
What the hell! If you're coming out, come out all at once! So annoying!
You mustn't, Lord Shapiro.
You've only just awakened... Don't push yourself...!
Hm...? Are those two units piloted...?
Now that you mention it... they move differently from the others.
Yes... they move differently from the rest.
...It is... It really is... Shapiro...
Saraaa! Get a grip! He's dead, Shapiro's dead!
He doesn't exist in this world... in this universe anymore!
...This looks... kinda bad. Oh, they're coming this way!
I'll protect Lord Shapiro... I will...!
I can't stop in a place like this!
Dammit! Just when I thought we'd thinned 'em out, there's more...
This is bad, Big Bro! With more enemies, we can't take 'em out fast!
Don't whine, Mike! ...But at this rate...
Hm... What's this...!? Heh, think we can't handle it alone!? ...Tobikage!!
Wow, long time no see!
Is it on our side...? Still, what insane speed...
I'd heard about it, but... wow, it can zip around even in space?
Right now we've gotta hurry. ...Tobikage, lend me your power!
Ngh... Mmph.
Did we get him...!?
Ah, he ran into that asteroid!
Bastard! Sara, Ryo, Masato! After him!
Huh!? Hold on, what about the colony!?
That's right! We're in the middle of chasing the colony!
You planning to go missing again!? You guys!
Wait! Are you going to disappear again!?
Don't forget your mission, Fujiwara... We can't lose Dancougar now...!
I know that! But...!
...Shinobu. It's fine.
Sara...
Right now... the colony comes first.
Man, this is frustrating.
If it's heading toward Earth, we can just deal with the colony first
and then take it out.
It'd be easy if things were that black-and-white. Right, Sara?
It took more time than expected... Dammit.
No use crying over it. Let's get to the next destination.
Yeah... I'm a little worried about leaving this place, though...
Homework for after we stop the colony.
Phew... Anyway, at least we managed to drive them off.
That took longer than I expected...
And Tobikage bailed us out again.
Dammit! Next time those guys show up, they're gonna pay!
But... I never thought the unit Shapiro Keats used
would show up in a place like this...
And now a moving planet... Is this asteroid out to invade Earth too?
This has become another place we can't ignore...
I don't really get it, but... we can't just leave it like this...
It won't attack unless we get close...
but a friendly conversation seems out of the question.
It's Shapiro, it's Shapiro...!
Sara? That's going a bit too far...
Shapiro's guiding them to Earth...!
Just like with the Muge...!
Hold on, Sara. You must've been wrong about seeing Shapiro!
Shinobu, I'm the one who killed Shapiro! Yeah, I loved him once...
But still... that was... that was Shapiro, no doubt about it!
Calm down, Sara. ...We haven't confirmed anything.
...His hatred... his grudges... all of that...
...didn't fade, even after he became space dust...!
Sara. Look, Sara... I know it's hard...
But Shapiro... the fact you killed Shapiro...
Try to put it behind you a little more.
...Let's go. Sara, I know how you feel, but... okay?
I'm not Fujiwara, but... something about this just doesn't sit right.
True... but right now we have to stop the colony.
It feels like there's more and more to worry about...
All we can do is carry out our missions, one at a time.
...And if this planet stands in our way while we do...
...we'll crush it.
...Right. Above all else, stopping the colony drop comes first.
We're leaving this area. All units, return...
